2026_12_NE_LAC.summary: Drake Maye's fractured ankle: the market has Tommy DeVito starting, and our ratings still rate New England with Maye.

reasons.text: QB Drake Maye fractured his right ankle in the Week 10 loss in Munich and could miss the rest of the season; Tommy DeVito is expected to start.
New England comes off two straight blowout losses (Lions, Packers) and a bye; the game was moved to 4:05 PM ET Nov 29.

2026_11_ARI_KC.summary: Arizona is down to rookie Carson Beck at QB; that covers some of the 2.5-point gap, not all of it.

reasons.text: QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) is on IR after UCL surgery; rookie Carson Beck started the 34-6 loss to the Rams.
DraftKings has Kansas City -16.5 with a 40.5 total.
Pushing the other way: Chiefs G Trey Smith (concussion), OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) and RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) missed Wednesday's practice.

swings.KC: Arizona lost QB Gardner Minshew to IR and starts rookie Carson Beck, so the market pushed Kansas City to -16.5, further than our ratings (ESPN / SI, Nov 18).

2026_11_MIN_SF.summary: Kyler Murray's hamstring likely keeps him out until Nov 29, so Minnesota starts Kirk Cousins; our ratings mix weeks with and without Murray.

reasons.text: QB Kyler Murray (grade 2 hamstring) is targeting a return Nov 29 vs Atlanta, which would mean missing this game; Kirk Cousins started the 30-10 win at Green Bay.
WR Jordan Addison had thumb surgery and is out.

returning.text: WR Jauan Jennings (calf) practiced fully Wednesday after missing time.

swings.MIN: QB Kyler Murray (grade 2 hamstring) is expected to miss this game and Kirk Cousins starts; the market dropped Minnesota, our ratings didn't (Fantasy Footballers, Nov 18).

2026_11_NO_CHI.summary: New Orleans' offensive line is in pieces and Chicago is 7-2 off its bye; that explains part of the 3-point gap.

reasons.text: Saints OT Asim Richards is out for weeks, and OT Taliese Fuaga and C Erik McCoy are doubtful: three offensive line starters.
Chicago (7-2) comes off its bye; Circa lists Bears -10.5, so books differ by a point.
Reports differ on whether Caleb Williams, who has not played since Week 9 per Squawka, is back; check his status before betting.

2026_12_CHI_DET.summary: Aidan Hutchinson's season-ending ACL tear moved this line from Detroit -2.5 (spring) to Chicago -2.5; that's worth about 2 of our 4-point gap.

reasons.text: DE Aidan Hutchinson (torn ACL) went on IR and is out for the season; C Cade Mays (ankle) is also hurt.
The early (May) line had Detroit -2.5, so the market has swung about 5 points since then.

swings.DET: DE Aidan Hutchinson tore his ACL and is out for the season; the market marked Detroit down, our ratings haven't caught up (ESPN, Nov 18).

2026_12_NYJ_MIA.summary: Miami is on Kyle McCord with Malik Willis on IR; that explains part of the gap, but some books still have Miami favored.

reasons.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord started the Week 10 loss.
Jets QB Geno Smith (ankle) was limited but says he will play.
Books disagree: StatSniper shows DraftKings at Miami -1.5, against the Jets -3 we use.
